evals.prompt: Review this one-page strategy: 'Grow revenue 20%, launch crypto, redesign the app, improve NPS.' Is it a strategy?
evals.expected_output: A review explaining that the document lists goals, not a strategy, then a draft structure with diagnosis, guiding policy, bets with assumptions and stop criteria.
expectations: Identifies the missing diagnosis and guiding policy
Asks for or proposes what the product will not do
Each proposed bet has an assumption, leading indicator and stop criterion
